section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body Appreciation Scale-2 (BAS-2), an improved self-report instrument for assessing positive body image comprising 10 items rated on a 5-point scale. The text notes that BAS-2 demonstrated strong psychometric properties with Cronbach's alpha values of 0.97 in the original version, 0.95 in Portuguese validation studies, and 0.95 in the present study, indicating it was used as the body appreciation assessment tool in the research being described.
